chunks: Abu Tayfour al-Mutattab said: I went to see Abu al-Hasan al-Madi (peace be upon him), and I cautioned him against drinking water.
So he (peace be upon him) said: 'What is the problem with water, when it circulates the food in the stomach, calms anger, increases intellect, and extinguishes bile?'

key_terms.اللُّبّ: al-lubb: the intellect, the inner essence of the mind; often contrasted with mere rationality to denote deeper wisdom
key_terms.الْمُتَطَبِّب: al-mutattab: the healer/physician; one who practices medicine
key_terms.الْمِرَار: al-mirar: bile; in classical Islamic medicine, an excess of bile (صفراء) was linked to anger, fever, and other ailments

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kazim say about the benefits of drinking water?
ai.summary: A physician named Abu Tayfour visited the 7th Imam, Musa al-Kazim (AS), and discouraged him from drinking water, perhaps out of some medical concern. The Imam responded by enumerating four benefits of water: it aids digestion by circulating food in the stomach, it calms anger, it increases intellectual capacity (lubb), and it extinguishes bile. This teaching, coming from a man with divine knowledge addressing a physician, reflects the Imam's broader role as a teacher of holistic well-being rooted in prophetic medicine.

en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun Al Basry, from Abu Tayfour Al Mutattab who said, 
‘I went over to Abu Al-Hassan Al-Maazy<sup>asws</sup> (7th Imam<sup>asws</sup>), so I said something negative about drinking the water,

so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And what is the problem with the water and it revolves the food in the stomach, and it settles the anger, and increases in the understanding ability, and extinguishes the bitterness’.
en.sarwar: 2. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Shammun al-Basriy from abu Tayfur al-Mutatabib who has said the following: “I once visited abu al-Hassan, al-Madiy, Alayhi al-Salam, and I prohibited him from drinking water.
He (the Imam) said, ‘What is wrong with water when it turns food in the stomach, calms down the anger, increases marrows (learning ability) and removes bitterness?”’
